popCulture.title: Iliad
popCulture.creator: Homer
popCulture.description: Son of Mecisteus who sails with Diomedes from Argos; a godlike warrior of the Epigoni line who falls before the wall in Patroclus' aristeia — not the Phaeacian athlete or Nisus' friend in the Aeneid.

popCulture.title: Euryalus
popCulture.description: Argive Euryalus son of Mecisteus at Troy — one of several mythic Euryali; here the Aeolid/Epigonid companion of Diomedes.
